name: Question 15
problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}16 \\ -1 \\ -18\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}16 \\ -1 \\ -18\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}5{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}16 \\ -1 \\ -18\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}16 \\ -1 \\ -18\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=16 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=-1 \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=-18\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $3$, the second equation by $2$, and adding the resulting equations, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}15{x}_{2}+8{x}_{2} & =48-2 \\ 23{x}_{2} & =46 \\ {x}_{2} & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we substitute ${x}_{2}=2$  into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} & =-1\text{ } \\ 3{x}_{1}+4(2) & =-1 \\ 3{x}_{1} & =-9 \\ {x}_{1} & =-3.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-3$ and ${x}_{2}=2$ into our third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} & =-18 \\ 4(-3)-3(2) & =-18 \\ -18 & =-18,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-3$ and ${x}_{2}=2,$ which means

$$
-3{a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-3)+2=-1.
$$

If x1a1+x2a2=b, then we have

x1[−234]+x2[54−3]=[16−1−18][−2x13x14x1]+[5x24x2−3x2]=[16−1−18][−2x1+5x23x1+4x24x1−3x2]=[16−1−18].

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

{−2x1+5x2=163x1+4x2=−14x1−3x2=−18

Multiplying the first equation by 3, the second equation by 2, and adding the resulting equations, we obtain 15x2+8x2=48−223x2=46x2=2. Now, we substitute x2=2 into the second equation to get

3x1+4x2=−1 3x1+4(2)=−13x1=−9x1=−3.

Finally, we substitute x1=−3 and x2=2 into our third equation to get

4x1−3x2=−184(−3)−3(2)=−18−18=−18, which gives a true statement.

So, the solution of the system is x1=−3 and x2=2, which means

−3a1+2a2=b.

Consequently,

x1+x2=(−3)+2=−1.
